create_CHAMMI_WTC_dataset: create a CHAMMI_WTC dataset instance with a specified split and root directory for cell painting data
load_file_names_and_targets: load image file paths and labels from the morphem70k metadata CSV for a given split
get_image_data: get the raw bytes of an image file at a given index from the CHAMMI_WTC dataset
get_targets: get all target labels as a numpy array from the CHAMMI_WTC dataset instance
review_CLASS_LABELS: review the CLASS_LABELS mapping that defines cell morphology stage labels M0 through M6M7_single
